scope: 14 existing IDs receive partial engineering/science observations; ordinary EEE and non-stream Chemistry only. Fourteen fee schedules were read in browser. No independent review, live portal or complete school enumeration.

records.scopeNote: A recognised undergraduate architecture/architectural-studies degree is required. Portfolio: at most 40 pages, including an English reflection of at most 500 words. Selected applicants may be interviewed. Plans to seek professional accreditation do not establish confirmed accreditation for this cohort.

Relevant degree, accepted academic/professional attainments, or assessed exceptional technical/management experience may qualify. Architecture/planning/construction training is preferred, not a universal named-major or numeric work-year exclusion. Dated accreditation references do not establish personal professional status.

Engineering/science degree or equivalent, eligibility for graduate professional membership, or other degrees assessed individually. Biomedical-related preparation has priority; it is not an exclusive subject list. Post-enrolment dissertation conditions are not undergraduate entry GPA.

Relevant science degree or assessed academic/professional attainments. Testing/certification employment is preferred, not mandatory work years. Ordinary non-stream modes only; the proposed Cosmetic Chemistry stream is subject to approval and is not another master. Semester-A CGPA 3.4 for a later elective is not an admission GPA.

Recognised degree or accepted equivalent academic/professional attainments; no universal named undergraduate subject restriction established. Only the ordinary 30-credit MSc is represented; 45-credit Industrial Research/Business Management options and their longer durations need separate selection evidence.

Physical science/engineering degree is the normal route. Other subjects may be assessed with A-level physics/equivalent or sufficient relevant experience. No automatic equivalence, numeric experience minimum or rejection of every other background is inferred.

Engineering, science or management degree, eligible professional membership, or accepted academic/professional attainments. Membership eligibility requires evidence; it is not inferred from degree title or total work years.

Listed biology, biomedical, medical and health-related degree routes are distinct from competitive other-science assessment. Broad preparation is preferred; additional support/assessment for limited health training does not become an invented numeric GPA or mandatory named course list.

Construction-related degree or accepted equivalent academic/professional attainments. Employer support and three post-graduation industry years are preferences, not mandatory minima. This record represents the 30-credit MSc; the intermediate 24-credit diploma is not another master or a cheaper MSc option.

Engineering/science degree, eligible professional membership, or accepted academic/professional attainments. No numeric work-year or entry GPA minimum established. Professional membership cannot be automatically confirmed from the form.

Relevant physical-science/engineering degree or eligibility for graduate membership of a relevant professional institution. Browser body and fee title use Materials Science and Engineering; older page metadata uses Materials Engineering and Nanotechnology. Keep one existing code/ID; no duplicate degree or assumed professional entitlement.

Mechanical or related engineering academic background is required; final-year applicants may apply if the qualification is obtained before the programme starts. Full-time dissertation study normally takes 1.5 years rather than one; no extra degree or automatic additional-credit charge is created.

Listed life-science, bioengineering, psychology, medical and biostatistics backgrounds or related disciplines. Broad prior preparation is preferred; limited health-related training requires assessment. No automatic course equivalence or numeric undergraduate GPA is established.

Relevant science/engineering degree or accepted academic/professional attainments. This is one physics MSc, not separate data-modelling and quantum degrees. Subject relevance and equivalence require assessment.
